title: Reopen the change that shaped a record
statement: As an architect investigating why a Saga record exists, I can inspect its change history and reopen the comparison for each event so I can understand what introduced or replaced it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: For a committed record, history lists each change event with its commit reason and separately indicates whether the current record has uncommitted changes.
Each history event with a resolvable prior boundary provides an open command whose against and head revisions identify the comparison in which the event occurred.
When a record is determined to replace another record, its history names the record it replaced.
